observations.note: The judge graded ts-rdg-answers MET from a grep hit on capability-list.spec.md without ever opening that file, though the brief requires reading each named file and grading PARTIAL when the only evidence is search output.
The findings text handed to the judge was truncated mid-word, so the judge graded citations it could not fully see and still gave ts-rdg-cited a MET.
The judge spent five reads on specs and routing code and one grep, then issued two MET grades without checking the findings' line ranges against the files they cite.
